verdict.rationale: Fastmail has a dedicated 'Offline support' help article, and an excerpt from it notes that snoozed messages won't reappear until you're back online. That implies an offline mode exists with some sync-on-reconnect behavior. JMAP's efficient change sync supports the reconciliation side. However, the pack never shows which actions work offline. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of offline reading, offline search, and offline composing/sending, documented behavior when changes sync on reconnect, and any hands-on or community corroboration of offline use.
